name: resource-manager
description: Resource Manager — the register. Reads this node's resources (cpu cores · gpus · ram · disks · Hydra shared folders · observed gpu processes) and keeps BOOKINGS: resources booked by a run are unassignable until popped or cleared. No internal logic — the Scheduler polls and decides; the only rule here is it won't allow double booking (1 app per gpu). Not enforcement — voluntary all the way.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run selftest
